details:
Yes, it happens sometimes.
Some old worlds stays for very long time in Community Labs. And someday, suddenly it meets the minimal visitors for a world and VRChat will publish the world as "New" world.
But you cannot publish world as new world if world is made in 2021, or even much older like 2020. That make no sense at all to publish very old worlds as NEW world. They will not work well for last 2019 changes / Udon. Not more working with SDK3 avatars.
So, there must date check on it. Not about visitors. You cannot put very old worlds in New worlds row in VRChat client. But it happens sometimes. And why are some suddenly come back. Mostly world is not interesting or have big problems, or just forgotten / lost. 
Still, it should not published and put in New worlds row.
The server logic need adjusted so world more than 1-2 month will not put in New worlds row. Published is oke, but must go in normal list, not as New world list.
It's not good this way, really. I am really surprised why it looks so ugly or has still problems, until i checked Last Update date. Really old world!
title: Community Labs bug: old worlds appear as new worlds.
